$schema: Describes the data model for populating a carousel template.
description: Each carousel is defined by metadata and an ordered array of slides. The template renders each slide using the appropriate layout based on its type field.

meta.title: Carousel display title
meta.footer_name: Author name in the final slide

slides.type: cover | box-list | arrow-list | grid-2x2 | bullet-list | final-cta
slides.number: Slide label e.g. SLIDE 1 OF 8 — COVER
slides.label: Optional uppercase label
slides.title: Slide heading
slides.quote: final-cta type: final quote in accent box
